summary: Read-only smoke test of fivezap4 branch (WhatsFlow). Backend: 62/62 pytest pass (health, login ok/wrong pw, /auth/me, 29 authenticated GETs return 200, same endpoints return 401 without token, public raffle). Frontend: login with Rithi0518@ redirects to dashboard; all 14 sidebar pages render with titles and content, no JS page errors; all 8 Configurações sections render; WhatsApp Conexão shows QR (base64 PNG, state awaiting_qr); Sair logs out and /customers redirects to /login; public /teste, /trevo, /pay/<painel id> (andrecartv) and invalid /pay id ('Link inválido') load without login. No write actions performed.

minor.issue: Returns total_customers=0 / active_customers=0 (local customers table empty) while Clientes page (painel cache /api/painel/users) shows 13 active users. Dashboard 'Clientes ativos 0' is inconsistent with Clientes page - data-source difference in upstream code, not a crash.

integration_issues.issue: App.js calls GET /api/settings at startup even on /login (no token) -> one benign 401 in network log. Harmless.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js: catch-all <Route path='*'> is declared before /coupons,/geografia,/sorteio,/documentacao,/settings - works due to RR v6 ranking, but cleaner to put it last.
App.js startup settingsApi.get() should be skipped on /login to avoid the 401.
seed_data_creation: None. No data created or modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: fivezap4 branch, SQLite backend. /api/auth/methods is intentionally public (email_login=false, password_login=true so login form is password-only). Customers list comes from /api/painel/users (painel.fun cache); a valid /pay id is a painel user id e.g. 227427597. Read-only constraint: no trials, renewals, raffle draws, WhatsApp sends, settings/password changes, system update.
